en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a large three‑story neoclassical building seen from the front, framed by tall leafless trees along a wide path leading to the main entrance. Several people stand on the steps and in the driveway. The facade features evenly spaced arched windows and an inscription along the upper central part of the building. Handwritten markings appear at the lower right corner.
